# One World Labs

> One World Labs (https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/) makes One World: one app with one login (One ID) for finding events, work and homes, plus an agency that builds and runs AI services for small businesses. The app lives at https://app.oneworldlabs.ai/. It is one download, not a set of separate apps: each product below is a part of the same app, and a member opens only the parts they need.

Key facts:
- Company: One World Labs. Consumer brand: One World.
- Two divisions: The Platform (the One World app) and The Agency (done-for-you AI services).
- One login, One ID, works across every part of the app.
- Markets: the United States and Colombia (Medellín). Languages: English and Spanish, with German, Russian, Chinese and Portuguese (Brazil) site translations.
- Contact: support@oneworldlabs.ai, +1-855-770-0200.

## The Platform: the One World app

Live now:
- [OneEvent](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/oneevent/): discover local events, buy tickets, or host your own with ticket sales and QR check-in.
- [OneJob](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onejob/): find work or hire talent, with the contract, payment and reviews for each job in one place.
- [OneHome](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onehome/): homes to rent or buy, and direct contact with the hosts and agents behind them.

Coming soon (built, in testing, not yet open to the public):
- [OneSocial](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onesocial/): your professional presence and social platforms in one profile.
- [OneScore](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onescore/): a reputation profile that brings together work, credentials and reviews.
- [OnePay](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onepay/): payments, transactions and receipts for small businesses.
- [OneAgent](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/oneagent/): a real middleman who finds and negotiates work for you.
- [One Business](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/onebusiness/): a business's services, leads and results in one workspace.

Overview of all parts: https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/apps/

## The Agency: done-for-you AI services
- [OneVoice](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/onevoice/): an AI receptionist that answers every call 24/7, books appointments, sends follow-up texts and updates your CRM.
- [OnePage](https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/onepage/): an AI-built business website, then hosted, updated and managed for you.
- [OneApp](https://oneapp.oneworldlabs.ai/): a business's own branded mobile app on the App Store and Google Play.
- Also: reputation and review management, search and AI-assistant visibility, missed-call text-back, AI chat for web and social, marketing automation, and custom AI agents.
- Full services menu: https://www.oneworldlabs.ai/services/
